Position Type: Full time

Job Requisition ID: 49560

Banner: Food Basics

Employment Type: Permanent

This position is part of a unionized bargaining unit. The hourly wage for this position starts at $18.00 - $21.35 and is established in accordance with the collective agreement. Depending on a candidateâs relevant knowledge, skills, education, and prior experience, a higher hourly wage may be offered. Any hourly wage offered for this role, whether starting or higher, will fall within the wage scale established for this position in accordance with the collective agreement.

This is a posting for an existing permanent full-time position

Experience a rewarding role at Food Basics as a Produce Clerk! You'll be the go-to person for ensuring our produce section is always fresh, well-stocked, and beautifully presented. Share your enthusiasm for fresh fruits and vegetables with our customers and help them find exactly what they need.

Our produce team is crucial to Food Basics' success, and we're looking for energetic individuals who love working with fresh food and enjoy helping others. If you thrive in a lively environment and are passionate about quality produce, we want you on our team!

What Youâll Do

  • Unload shipments of produce and sort items in the backroom and cooler.
  • Stock shelves and displays with fresh produce, ensuring items are rotated (first-in, first-out method) to maintain freshness.
  • Create visually appealing displays and arrange items neatly.
  • Inspect produce for freshness and quality, removing any damaged or spoiled items.
  • Ensure that all produce meets the store's quality standards.
  • Monitor temperature and humidity levels in the produce section to maintain optimal storage conditions.
  • Assist customers with locating specific items and provide information about different produce or products in other departments.
  • Offer recommendations on how to select and store produce.
  • Answer customer inquiries and address concerns.
  • Keep the produce section clean and organized, including sweeping and mopping as needed.
  • Clean and sanitize work areas, equipment, and tools regularly.
  • Dispose of waste and compostable materials properly.
  • Monitor inventory levels and restock items as needed.
  • Perform regular inventory counts and report any discrepancies.
  • Notify management of low stock or out-of-stock items.
  • Ensure all produce is correctly labeled with prices and product information.
  • Update signage for promotions, sales, and seasonal items.
  • Verify that prices in the system match the displayed prices.
  • Reduce and price items as needed.
  • Adhere to food safety and sanitation guidelines.
  • Use equipment and tools safely and properly.
  • Report any safety concerns or incidents to management.
  • Assist with gathering shopping carts or baskets and putting them away when needed.
  • Assist with special promotions, events, or projects as assigned by management.
  • Collaborate with other departments as needed.
  • Additional duties assigned by Management.

Qualifications

  • Customer service driven.
  • Able to stock merchandise and create displays.
  • Good product knowledge and attention to detail.
  • Able to lift between 30 to 50 pounds.
  • Retail experience is considered an asset.
  • Able to stand for extend periods of time.
  • Must be available to work flexible shifts which may include nights, weekends and holidays.

The responsibilities and relationships assigned to this role may change as is necessary to achieve Metro's business objectives.

JOB TITLE: Building Maintenance Technician


SALARY: CI$50,000 - CI$70,000 pa


WORKING HOURS: 40 HOURS PER WEEK


TERM OF EMPLOYMENT: Full-Time


We are seeking a Building Maintenance Technician to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of building infrastructure and systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation of facilities.


DO YOU HAVE:


A high school diploma (or equivalent) and a valid trade license

A minimum of 5 yearsâ experience in building maintenance within Class A Commercial properties

Strong HVAC experience in chilled water and DX systems

Training and certification in electrical, plumbing, HVAC systems maintenance, Pool Operator and Man Lift operation

A valid Cayman Islands driverâs license

The ability to operate hand and power tools required, in a safe and efficient manner

Strong knowledge of building, electrical, plumbing and MEP systems, including related equipment, tools, hazards and safety precautions

Strong communication, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills

The ability to perform physically demanding manual work for extended periods in varying and sometimes adverse conditions is required, including working in inclement weather and with regular exposure to dust and noise, as well as heavy lifting, prolonged standing, and climbing

The willingness to travel between sites, work at heights, and work outside regular business hours as required

The ability to read and interpret schematic drawings and blueprints (preferred)

A commitment to safety, continuous improvement, and professional development


WE WANT YOU TO:


Inspect, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire life safety, and other building systems

Diagnose faults using schematic drawings, manuals, and blueprints, and complete corrective maintenance efficiently

Assess faulty equipment, determine repair or replacement needs, review manufacturer specifications and technical documentation, and source the required parts or materials

Adhere to the DE Engineering Health and Safety Manual and maintain accurate maintenance records

Respond to corrective maintenance requests and urgent faults, diagnosing root causes and completing repairs effectively

Inspect and maintain building exteriors, residential units, appliances, fixtures, pools, and site features

Inspect, operate, maintain, and repair HVAC, solar systems, lighting, and related building systems while identifying performance issues and implementing system upgrades as required

Support contractor coordination, disaster preparedness, and recovery activities

Communicate effectively, work collaboratively, promote a safe customer-focused environment, and demonstrate professionalism and sound judgment


Compensation & Benefits


At Dart, we're committed to creating a workplace where you thrive, offering a competitive salary and benefits designed for your well-being and growth. Our package includes 100% employer-paid medical insurance premium for the employee, employee and employer pension contributions, life insurance and long-term disability coverage (conditions apply), enhanced leave options including vacation, personal days, maternity, paternity, a wellness screening day and continuing professional development opportunities after successful completion of a six-month probationary period.


DEADLINE: Midnight, Friday 18 September 2026.

opportunities.description:
• Full-time, ongoing
  • Commencing Term 1, 2027
  • Salary commensurate with years of Service
  • Continuous professional development opportunities
  • Generous staff benefits


English at Pembroke is taught by a large, dynamic team across Years 7 to 12, spanning both SACE and the International Baccalaureate. Our Middle School curriculum has been recently redesigned around conceptual threads and a portfolio-based approach to assessment that prioritises the process of learning, not just its products. Our teachers enjoy considerable freedom in text selection, within a framework of high academic expectations, and our faculty culture is one of collegiality, intellectual curiosity and serious engagement with pedagogy. Our staff contribute to curriculum design, and are supported to grow as practitioners at every career stage.


About the Role

Successful applicants will teach across the secondary years, with allocations shaped by experience and strengths. Depending on the appointment, this may include Middle School classes, senior SACE English subjects, or IB Diploma Language A courses.


Key Responsibilities include:

  • Delivering engaging, rigorous and innovative English lessons that foster a love of learning
  • Supporting students to develop strong literacy, analytical and communication skills
  • Providing purposeful assessment and feedback that supports every students' growth
  • Contributing to a positive and collaborative culture across the Middle and Senior Schools
  • Actively participating in the life of the School through co-curricular and pastoral care contributions.


About You

You are an effective teacher first and foremost, with demonstrated impact on student learning and a command of your subject that lets you teach with both rigour and imagination.


You will bring:

  • Strong subject knowledge and a love of literature and language that students can feel
  • Evidence-informed, responsive pedagogy and high expectations of every learner
  • Capacity or willingness to teach across SACE and IB pathways (IB experience is valued but not required; training and support are provided)
  • Strong communication with students, families and colleagues
  • A collaborative disposition and a genuine interest in contributing to faculty and school life


Applications at All Career Stages

We welcome applications from experienced practitioners and from graduate and early-career teachers alike. Early-career appointees are supported through structured mentoring and induction as part of a faculty that takes professional growth seriously.


Required for Employment (Prior to Commencement)

  • Current Working with Children Check (South Australia)
  • Current Plink RRHAN-EC training: Masterclass and Fundamentals, including Protective Practices
  • First Aid and CPR


Find Your Place At Pembroke

At Pembroke, youâll be part of a warm and collaborative school community that values relationships, initiative, and a shared commitment to learning. Whether in the classroom, on the sporting field, or behind the scenes, every role contributes to shaping the rich and inclusive culture of the School. With opportunities for professional growth, a strong sense of belonging, and a genuine appreciation for staff, Pembroke is a place where your work is seen, valued, and celebrated.


Read more in The Heart of Pembroke - Celebrating our Staff.


Pembroke School is a co-educational, non-denominational, day and boarding School from Early Learning Centre to Year 12. Renowned for academic excellence and a broad, inclusive program, Pembroke offers the South Australian Certificate of Education (SACE) and is also an International Baccalaureate World School, offering the IB Diploma Programme (IBDP) and Primary Years Programme (PYP).


Pembroke is a vibrant and exciting School catering for a diverse community of students. With over 1,700 students, the School offers a broad-ranging curriculum and an outstanding choice of co-curricular opportunities. The School employs over 300 permanent and fixed-term staff, plus more than 150 casual employees.


Pembroke seeks to engage outstanding, diverse and well-qualified staff to work in our welcoming and open School. All staff work together to provide an environment that facilitates each studentâs exploration of their potential, academic progress and personal welfare. Staff are encouraged to maintain a collaborative approach, a broad outlook within their respective field and a commitment to ongoing professional development and continuous improvement. Pembroke is a lively and fulfilling place to work.

  • You are required to upload a CV and a cover letter (maximum 2 pages) identifying your interest in applying and what you could bring to the role.
  • Your application should be addressed to the Acting Principal, Mr Chris Zielinski.
  • The School reserves the right to shortlist and interview candidates before the closing date. Early applications are strongly encouraged.
  • For any enquiries regarding this position, please email talent@pembroke.sa.edu.au
  • Please do not email your applications.
